# Divyansh Sood® Studio

> Independent web design & development studio run by Divyansh Sood. We build custom-coded, conversion-focused websites, online stores and web apps for businesses worldwide — strategy, interface and engineering under one roof. Typical sites go live in about 3–4 weeks.

Last updated: 2026-07-23. Full-length version with expanded detail: https://www.divyanshsood.com/llms-full.txt

Divyansh Sood is a freelance web designer and developer based in Himachal Pradesh, India, working with clients globally. Every project is custom-coded (no page-builder templates) and starts from how customers actually make decisions — then design and engineering follow. The studio handles strategy, UX/UI design, front-end and full-stack development, e-commerce, SEO and ongoing growth.

- Founder: Divyansh Sood (Freelance Web Designer & Developer)
- Location: Himachal Pradesh, India — available worldwide
- Established: 2022
- Positioning: premium, custom-coded, conversion-focused — most projects live in ≈3–4 weeks
- Stacks: React, Next.js, Astro, Angular, Tailwind, Supabase, Razorpay, headless CMS

## Services

- **Strategy & Research**: Customer-journey audit, drop-off analysis, and a clear path from first click to conversion — grounded in real behaviour.
- **Design & Prototyping**: High-fidelity interface design and clickable prototypes before any code is written — typography, motion, states.
- **Development**: Fast, accessible, search-friendly front-ends and full-stack builds — React, Next.js, Astro, Angular or headless.
- **Support & Growth**: Ongoing iteration once live — A/B tests, new pages, performance tuning and monthly reporting.
- **SEO / AEO / GEO**: Technical and on-page SEO from day one — clean markup, fast loads, structured data, llms.txt, and content built to rank and be quoted by AI answer engines.

## Service pages

- [All services](https://www.divyanshsood.com/services/): Overview hub — five ways the studio helps: ecommerce, web apps, AI development, landing pages, SEO/GEO.
- [Ecommerce website development](https://www.divyanshsood.com/services/ecommerce-website-development/): Custom-coded D2C storefronts — Razorpay/Stripe payments, drop mechanics, full code ownership, no Shopify themes or platform rent. Live in 2–4 weeks.
- [Web app development](https://www.divyanshsood.com/services/web-app-development/): MVPs, portals, dashboards, admin panels and AI products — full-stack React/Next.js/Astro, live in weeks (fastest: 7 days).
- [AI development](https://www.divyanshsood.com/services/ai-development/): AI features shipped to production — LLM integration, retrieval (RAG) over your own content, AI search and support, and complete AI products. Built on Claude, GPT or Gemini; the studio runs its own AI product (WebSeek.ai) on all three.
- [Landing page design](https://www.divyanshsood.com/services/landing-page-design/): High-converting landing pages — copy, design and code as one argument, with tracking built in.
- [SEO & GEO services](https://www.divyanshsood.com/services/seo-geo-services/): Technical SEO plus Generative Engine Optimization — structured data, llms.txt, AI-crawler strategy — implemented directly in the codebase so Google ranks you and AI assistants cite you.

## FAQ

- **Do you write the copy, or do we?** Either works — conversion-focused copy written for you, or polishing what you provide. Most projects are a collaboration.
- **What happens after launch?** A tidy handover, documentation, and 30 days of free support, with an optional ongoing retainer.
- **How long does a project take?** Most projects go live in about 3–4 weeks. A limited number of projects are taken on at once, so each gets full attention.
- **What if I'm not happy with the result?** Work runs in clear milestones with revision rounds; nothing ships until you're genuinely happy.
